data.heading: Week 1 (06 Feb - 12 Feb 2026):
data.text: -  Minimum  Temperature  is  likely  to  be  below  normal  in  East  India,  East  M.P.,  East  U.P., Marathwada, Vidarbha and in South India.

data.heading: Week 2 (13 Feb - 19 Feb 2026):
data.text:
-  Minimum Temperature is likely to  be  below  normal in many parts of East  India,  Central India,  South India, many parts of Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Punjab and many parts of West Rajasthan.
-  Minimum temperatures are likely to be  near normal or slightly  below  normal  (by 1-2°C) over most parts of the country except East India, where they are likely to be below normal by 2-4°C.
-  Cold wave and Dense fog conditions are unlikely over any part of the country during the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Wheat: About  334.17  lakh  ha  (107%  of  normal)  area  coverage  under  Wheat  has  been reported as compared to 328.04 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Rapeseed & Mustard : About 89.36 (113% of normal) lakh ha area coverage under Rapeseed &  Mustard  has  been  reported  as  compared  to  86.57  lakh  ha  during  the  corresponding period of last year.
-  Gram: About 96.20 (95.2% of normal) lakh ha area coverage under Gram has been reported as compared to 91.22 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
